documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM
Corrigendum To The Notice Of First Extra Ordinary General Meeting Of Financial Year 2026-27.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong Q1 FY27 performance with AUM expanding 61% year-on-year to INR 8,001 crores and profit after reaching INR 95 crores, up 59% year-on-year. Credit costs improved to 6.80% of average AUM, driven by a deliberate strategy to target higher-quality customers and increase off-book lending to 53.6%. The company reaffirmed its full-year guidance across parameters including AUM growth upwards of 40% and a 15% reduction in credit costs. OnEMI Technology Solutions Limited reported its Q1 FY2027 performance, highlighting a successful NSE and BSE listing in May 2026 and an AUM cross of ₹8,001 crore. Profit After Tax grew 59% YoY to ₹95 crore, backed by strong asset quality with a GNPA of 2.25%.

guidance.claim: The company reaffirmed its expectation of over 40% overall growth for the next 12 months.
guidance.quote: Now simple mathematics will tell you that if we have already grown 13% in one quarter, you know, we are only going to overachieve that. So the point I was making on guidance is we remain firmly confident of over-delivering on the number that we had given last quarter of 40%.

guidance.claim: Management firmly holds to the guidance of a 15% reduction in credit cost.
guidance.quote: We firmly hold to our guidance which we gave last quarter, which is 15% reduction in credit cost, and we are tracking well on that.

guidance.claim: Management stated they remain firmly on track for the FY27 guidance set out on parameters including AUM, Gross NPA, credit cost, and profitability.
guidance.quote: On the guidance for future, we remain firmly on track for the FY27 guidance we set out on different parameters, be it AUM, Gross NPA, credit cost, and profitability including ROE and ROA.

guidance.claim: The company expects AUM to grow at over 40% with disciplined asset quality and calibrated risk selection.
guidance.quote: We expect to grow at north of 40% in AUM, with disciplined asset quality and calibrated risk selection, while secured business scale-up is also expected to be strong.

guidance.claim: Management targets gross NPA below 2.25% for the future period.
guidance.quote: On asset quality, we are targeting gross NPA below 2.25%, year-on-year reduction in impairment costs of 10%-15%, and continued improvement in Stage-1 mix.

guidance.claim: The company targets return on average AUM in the range of 4.5% to 5%.
guidance.quote: On profitability, we are targeting a return on average AUM in the range of 4.5%-5%, which entails a return on average equity in the range of 19-21%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that bureau data for the industry reveals a clear divergence beneath a calm surface, with stress building in small-ticket loans and among borrowers carrying debt across multiple lenders.
demand_outlook.quote: The bureau data for the industry now shows a clear divergence beneath a calm surface. Talking about industry, headline asset quality looks benign, yet beneath the surface, stress is building, concentrated in a few places, particularly in the small ticket loans or instances of borrowers carrying debt across several lenders at once, and households taking new lines only to service old ones.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed that for the industry, the quality of new customers has softened even as headline delinquencies in personal loans improved.
demand_outlook.quote: For the industry, the quality of new customers has softened even as headline delinquencies in personal loans have improved - both are true at once.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic about India's long-term structural credit opportunity while remaining realistic about near-term conditions.
demand_outlook.quote: As we look ahead to FY27, we remain optimistic about India's long-term structural credit opportunity. Many reasons for that, not only economic growth that the country will see, but also the huge degree of credit under penetration which exists, while at the same time being realistic and cautious about near-term conditions.

capex_expansion.claim: The Loan Against Property (LAP) AUM stands at INR 617 crores across 101 branches in eight states.
capex_expansion.quote: LAP business which we started two years back, the AUM stands at INR 617 crores across 101 branches in eight states, about 7.7% of the total AUM.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has begun building capabilities in mutual fund distribution and its subsidiary has secured an AMFI registration.
capex_expansion.quote: Separately, we have begun to build capabilities in mutual fund distribution. The rationale for this, is a large proportion of our customers have invested in SIPs and mutual funds over time. An offering like this will help serve them well and enhance our fee income. Our subsidiary has secured an AMFI registration already.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to add at least 80 more branches for the LAP business by the end of the financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: We plan to have at least 80 more branches by end of this financial year.

margins_costs.claim: Pre-provisioning operating profit was INR 256 crores, up 42% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: Pre-provisioning operating profit was INR 256 crores, which is up 42% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Opex as a proportion of AUM came down from 19.9% to 18.0%.
margins_costs.quote: You must have seen the operating leverage some evidence of that, 19.9% cost which was opex as a proportion of AUM has already come down to 18.0% percent.

orders_capacity.claim: Registered users grew 33% year-on-year to 74.6 million, and customer count reached 12.25 million, up 26% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: The registered users grew 33% year-on-year to 74.6 million. We have now served 12.25 million customers, an increase of 26% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: Loan Against Property AUM stands at nearly ₹ 518 crore across 98 branches in 8 states.
orders_capacity.quote: LAP AUM stands at nearly ₹ 518 crore, across 98 branches in 8 states, contributing 7.3% of total AUM.

orders_capacity.claim: On-book AUM stands at ₹ 3,556 crore supported by more than 45 lending partners.
orders_capacity.quote: On-book AUM stands at ₹ 3,556 crore, supported by 45+ lending partners, where cost of borrowing has been between 11.5% and 14.25%.

orders_capacity.claim: Off-book AUM stands at ₹ 3,510 crore with FLDG provided up to 5%.
orders_capacity.quote: Off-book AUM stands at ₹ 3,510 crore, where we provide FLDG up to 5%, which is the First Loss Default Guarantee.

capital_allocation.claim: Capital adequacy in the NBFC subsidiary rose to 40.2% from 25.3% last quarter following the IPO.
capital_allocation.quote: Capital adequacy in our NBFC subsidiary rose to 40.2% from 25.3% last quarter. Net worth grew to INR 2,245 crores, nearly four times its level in March 2023, built on retained earnings, organic profitability, and the IPO completed in May 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Approximately ₹ 630 crore of the primary issue has already been infused as fresh equity into NBFC subsidiary Si Creva Capital.
capital_allocation.quote: 75% of the primary issue, approximately ₹ 630 crore have been already infused as fresh equity into our NBFC subsidiary, which is Si Creva Capital.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that West Asia poses a potential risk through higher oil prices, shipping costs, and customer confidence transmission.
risks_headwinds.quote: The first is West Asia, where the risk is not geography but transmission through higher oil prices, the cost of shipping, and, over time, the confidence of the customer.

risks_headwinds.claim: Based on early warning systems, the company paused lending across approximately 450 pin codes last quarter, and has since reopened about 40% of them.
risks_headwinds.quote: Just to give you an instance, last quarter, out of caution, we paused lending across roughly 450 pin codes based on what our early warning system had flagged. We have re-examined those pin codes since. The signals have turned modestly positive, and we have reopened approximately 40% of these pin codes already.

risks_headwinds.claim: Credit cost was 6.80% of average AUM, down from 7.02% in Q4 FY26 and 8.85% in Q1 FY26.
risks_headwinds.quote: Credit cost was 6.80% of average AUM, down from 7.02% in Q4 FY26 and 8.85% in Q1 FY26.

risks_headwinds.claim: Stage 2 stood at 3.15%, Gross NPA at 2.25%, Net NPA at 0.36%, and collection efficiency at 96.82%.
risks_headwinds.quote: Stage 2 stood at 3.15%. Stage 2 has improved from 3.9% to 3.15% year-on-year. The increase compared with last quarter is very seasonal in nature, something that we have seen almost every Q1 of the year. Gross NPA at 2.25%, very range bound. Net NPA at 0.36% and collection efficiency at 96.82%, which shows our resilience to risk management.

risks_headwinds.claim: Higher oil prices, elevated rates, geopolitical disruptions, and currency volatility are factors weighing on India.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global environment has been one of the defining themes of the recent past - higher oil prices, elevated rates, geopolitical disruptions, currency volatility, these are all the factors weighing on India too.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they remain confident of over-delivering on the full-year AUM growth guidance of upwards of 40%.
management_commitments.quote: So the point I was making on guidance is we remain firmly confident of over-delivering on the number that we had given last quarter of 40%.

management_commitments.claim: Management anticipates the cost of borrowing to drop by a minimum of 100 basis points in the second half of the fiscal year.
management_commitments.quote: So our guidance for FY, particularly H2 of FY27, that you will see the cost of borrowing dropping by 100 basis points and it will only increase as we, as the old debt basically runs off the book, right?

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the Loan Against Property business to achieve breakeven around the third quarter of the year.
management_commitments.quote: Somewhere around Q3 of this year, it will only be delivering the desired ROE for which we started the business.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets AUM growth of over 40% for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to grow at north of 40% in AUM, with disciplined asset quality and calibrated risk selection, while secured business scale-up is also expected to be strong.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets gross NPA below 2.25% and impairment cost reduction of 10%-15%.
management_commitments.quote: On asset quality, we are targeting gross NPA below 2.25%, year-on-year reduction in impairment costs of 10%-15%, and continued improvement in Stage-1 mix.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets return on average AUM in the range of 4.5% to 5% with ROE of 19% to 21%.
management_commitments.quote: On profitability, we are targeting a return on average AUM in the range of 4.5%-5%, which entails a return on average equity in the range of 19-21%.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to add at least 80 more branches for the LAP business by the end of the financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We plan to have at least 80 more branches by end of this financial year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
